page_title: Kingdom of the Netherlands: Order of Oranje-Nassau
directory_label: Order of Oranje-Nassau
date_candidates: Instituted: 4 April 1892 by the Queen Dowager Emma.
Awarded: To Dutchmen and foreigners who have proved themselves to be specially deserving towards the Head of State or society in general.
dated: 12 December 2017
grade_or_material_clues: ODM of The Netherlands: Order of Oranje-Nassau Kingdom of the Netherlands: Order of Oranje-Nassau Orde van Oranje-Nassau Ribbon: Orange with blue and white edges. Instituted: 4 April 1892 by the Queen Dowager Emma. Awarded: To Dutchmen and foreigners who have proved themselves to be specially deserving towards the Head of State or society in general. Grades: 5 (Grand Cross, Grand Officer, Commander, Officer and Knight) in Civil and Military Divisions plus 3 Medals. In 1994, the Medals were abolished and replaced by the class of Member, which may only be awarded to citizens of The Netherlands.
